answer_1.quote: Text summarization aims to produce concise and accurate summaries of long texts.

answer_2.quote: We report ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, and ROUGE-L scores to evaluate generated summaries against references.

answer_4.quote: We evaluate the performance of DIONYSUS by conducting human evaluation experiments on Amazon Mechanical Turk.
answer_4.guideline: Participants are asked to rate the summaries on a scale of 1 to 5, with higher scores indicating better quality.
